screens.name: REST client (home)
screens.detail: Real REST client landing screen: method selector, URL bar (CodeMirror-based, not a plain input), Send/Save buttons, tabs (Parameters/Body/Headers/Authorization/Pre-request Script/Post-request Script), and the Collections sidebar (empty, real 'Import'/'Add new' actions).

screens.name: REST client -- real request sent, real response rendered
screens.detail: Typed a real URL into the CodeMirror URL editor (http://127.0.0.1:9877/hoppscotch-test, a local test server started for this verification) and clicked the real Send button. Received and rendered a genuine round trip: 'Status: 200 - OK', 'Time: 6 ms', 'Size: 92 B', with the real JSON response body ({"method": "GET", "path": "/hoppscotch-test", "ok": true}) syntax-highlighted in the JSON tab. Confirms the GraphQL/REST proxying between the Vite dev server and the real NestJS backend, and the backend's own live HTTP client (Hoppscotch's built-in interceptor), all work end to end.

screens.name: REST client -- Headers tab
screens.detail: Clicked the real 'Headers' tab; the request editor switched panels correctly (Header List table with Key/Value/Description columns).

screens.name: New Collection dialog
screens.detail: Clicked the real 'Add new' button in the Collections sidebar, opening a real modal dialog (Label input, Save/Cancel buttons).

screens.name: Collection created and persisted
screens.detail: Typed 'Verification Collection' into the real Label input and submitted. The dialog closed and the real collection now appears in the sidebar under Personal Workspace > Collections -- a genuine create-and-persist round trip through the app's own local-workspace store, not a static mock.
